name: Gelihast
summary: In Blackfathom Deeps, Gelihast guards a strange altar in the flooded Pool of Ask'ar. His Blindlight murlocs gather around him in the sunken temple.

sections.title: A Deadly Calling
sections.body: Deep beneath the Zoram Strand, Gelihast has claimed a lair in Blackfathom Deeps. Most murlocs keep to coastal shallows, but he strikes at intruders with twin swords, moving too quickly for many to react. Casters who come within his reach rarely survive.

sections.title: Master of the Blindlight
sections.body: Gelihast rules the Pool of Ask'ar with his Blindlight brood, who swarm to his side at the first sign of trouble. An altar stands beyond his lair. Those who defeat him and touch it receive the Blessing of Blackfathom.

faq.answer: Gelihast commands the Blindlight tribe in the Pool of Ask'ar, deep within Blackfathom Deeps. He fights with twin blades at blinding speed.

faq.q: Why is Gelihast inside Blackfathom Deeps?
aliases: why is there a murloc in bfd
why is gelihast in the temple
faq.answer: No one knows what first drew Gelihast to Blackfathom Deeps. He and his Blindlight murlocs have claimed the Pool of Ask'ar in the flooded ruins, which he defends savagely against intruders.

faq.q: How did the Twilight's Hammer react to him?
faq.answer: Nothing is recorded of Gelihast's dealings with the Twilight's Hammer cultists deeper in the temple. He rules his own pool with his Blindlight murlocs.

faq.q: What is the altar behind Gelihast?
faq.answer: An altar stands beyond Gelihast's pool. Travelers who defeat him can touch it to receive the Blessing of Blackfathom.

faq.q: What tribe of murlocs does he lead?
faq.answer: Gelihast leads the Blindlight murlocs, an aggressive tribe that infests the Pool of Ask'ar within the caverns.

faq.q: What happens to Gelihast if he is left unchecked?
faq.answer: Gelihast and his Blindlight murlocs keep the Pool of Ask'ar closed to anyone seeking to venture deeper into the sunken temple.

angles.text: Gelihast attacks with blinding sword speed. As a warrior, you can brace yourself and turn his frantic dual-blade assault against him.
As an Alliance adventurer seeking to cleanse the corruption leaking into Ashenvale, you must remove Gelihast to secure the submerged temple's northern passages.
As a Horde adventurer sent to scour Blackfathom Deeps, you must eliminate Gelihast to clear the way deeper into the sunken temple beneath the Zoram Strand.
